The '''Muuria system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Muur]],<ref name="RPG" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> and it also shared its name with the company [[Muurian Interstellar]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Muuria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square M-13.<ref name="TEA" />
